summary: 68-ft Aermotor ladder tower; placed in 1928 or erected in 1929 (sources differ); listed as standing; no current condition, access or later staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no recent condition report found

events.note: Brainerd Daily Dispatch item of 29 Dec 1928, quoted by Forest Lookouts, lists a 68-foot tower placed on a hill southeast of Emily
Minnesota fire lookout list gives the year erected as 1929
April 1929 newspaper item says Mr. and Mrs. Taft Kirvan expected to move to Emily, where he would work as watchman in the fire tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The December 1928 newspaper item says a tower was placed that year; the Minnesota list says it was erected in 1929. The story reports both and does not choose.

Forest Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association say Cass County. The Minnesota list appears to give Crow Wing for the same row, but the PDF layout is ambiguous. The story reports the disagreement without choosing.

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers, A-Z list

notes_for_editor: Build year (1928 placement vs 1929 erection) and county (Cass vs apparent Crow Wing) conflict; the story reports both. No current condition, access, rental or later staffing record found. The Forest Lookouts Emily page holds no further text beyond the 1928 and 1929 items.
